title: Latency-contour routing explainer & compact map tile set for onboarding
creator: Marina K. Lopez
description: Goal: Create a set of onboarding-ready visuals that explain Redwood's latency-aware routing using latency-contour bands (an alternative to heatmaps) plus compact map tiles and console screenshots. Deliverables should be embeddable across quickstart docs, the Console onboarding tour, and marketing one-pagers. Scope includes: 1) a 3-frame explainer diagram (how requests are routed, failover behavior, and cache/batch benefits), 2) lightweight vector contour tiles (SVG) at multiple retina sizes, 3) annotated Console mock screenshots showing region selection, latency overlay toggle, and fallback chain, and 4) mobile/CLI quickstart card assets (static + animated 1s ping ring loop). This ticket covers design, export-ready assets, and an initial dev handoff package (export guidelines + example embed code snippets).
acceptance_criteria: Three explainer diagrams (SVG) finalized and exported at 1x/2x with layered source in Figma
Vector latency-contour tiles available for Console: desktop (1200px width) and mobile (360px), responsive SVG/PNG fallbacks included
Console mock screenshots with annotated callouts (region pin clustering, prefix cache indicator, fallback arrow) reviewed and signed off by PM
Small animated ping-ring GIF and a compact 320x180 SVG micro-illustration for quickstart card
Design handoff doc with asset naming, color tokens (light/dark), and integration notes provided to ENG and Docs
assets_needed: PNG exports for legacy embed: contour_tiles_png.zip
